sentences.en: There was a loud bang as the front door slammed with Cynthia's violent departure.
sentences.vi: Có một tiếng nổ lớn khi cánh cửa trước đóng sầm lại với sự ra đi đầy bạo lực của Cynthia.
Sau đó, bang, bang, anh ta chết.

sentences.en: She continued to bang away on her keyboard, the smile etched on her face.

sentences.en: No matter how you wear it, the bang is just plain hot!

sentences.en: They also begin to transfer objects from hand to hand, and bang objects together.

sentences.en: A half wig will usually start halfway back from the hair line, allowing an individual's bang or frontal hairline to be visible.

sentences.en: I've often used the phrase "you get a lot of bang for your buck."
